activity_context.topic_title: Expressing the Coordinates of a Vector in a Given Basis

feedback.problem:
Find the vector $x$, if $B={{b}_{1},{b}_{2}}$ is a basis of $\text{Span}{{b}_{1},{b}_{2}},$ and 

$$
{b}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}7 \\ -4 \\ 3\end{aligned}],\,{b}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}5 \\ 8 \\ -9\end{aligned}],\,[x]_{B}=[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ 5\end{aligned}].
$$
feedback.worked_solution:
We know that any vector in  $\text{Span}{{b}_{1},{b}_{2}}$ has the form

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}[\begin{aligned}7 \\ -4 \\ 3\end{aligned}]+{x}_{2}[\begin{aligned}5 \\ 8 \\ -9\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

where ${x}_{1}$ and ${x}_{2}$ are the coordinates relative to the basis $\,B.$ Since we are told that $[x]_{B}=[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ 5\end{aligned}],$ we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}x & ={{(-1)}_{⏟}}_{{x}_{1}}[\begin{aligned}7 \\ -4 \\ 3\end{aligned}]+{{(\,5\,)}_{⏟}}_{{x}_{2}}[\begin{aligned}5 \\ 8 \\ -9\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-7 \\ 4 \\ -3\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}25 \\ 40 \\ -45\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}18 \\ 44 \\ -48\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$
